video_title: Spencer Jones On Failure, Focus, And The Future | Denver Nuggets Off The Court

quotes.speaker: Spencer Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Spencer Jones on his transition from college to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: For me it was just a great way to summarize my whole Stanford experience
quotes.quote: I got started pretty much as soon as my college career ended. I wrote an article just summarizing my unique experience through college, the fact that every year changed, coming in 2019, leaving in 2024. For me it was just a great way to summarize my whole Stanford experience and keep in contact with all the connections I made there.

quotes.speaker: Spencer Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Spencer Jones on balancing NBA play with business ventures
quotes.excerpt: I've been able to balance playing at the highest level on the NBA floor while also conducting
quotes.quote: I think the fact that I've been able to balance playing at the highest level on the NBA floor while also conducting and building a business portfolio off the floor and managing that time, the unique skills of translating both, I feel like it's a pretty unique experience.

quotes.speaker: Spencer Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Spencer Jones on the difficult decision to stay at Stanford for a fifth year
quotes.excerpt: Staying at Stanford for my fifth year was a bit of a difficult decision.
quotes.quote: Staying at Stanford for my fifth year was a bit of a difficult decision. At the time NIL was still fairly new, but a couple years along, so there were guys still making six figures and stuff like that. I had to make a decision on whether I wanted to stay and be a Stanford athlete through my full five years and really build and maintain those connections, or capitalizing on the fact that other schools were giving me about twice as much as Stanford was offering me that last year.

quotes.speaker: Spencer Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Spencer Jones on his expectations during training camp
quotes.excerpt: I didn't have too big of an expectation. I knew the role was going to be small.
quotes.quote: I didn't have too big of an expectation. I knew the role was going to be small. We made great additions to the team, it was super deep. But I still knew throughout the summer and being here all summer, you get hints and tidbits from coaches on what they're looking for from you. For me it was just show I can guard effectively and know that that's my role out there for however many minutes it's going to be.

quotes.speaker: Spencer Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Spencer Jones on Junior Bridgeman as a role model
quotes.excerpt: Junior Bridgeman was a big one. He used to play for the Milwaukee Bucks back in 80s.
quotes.quote: Junior Bridgeman was a big one. He used to play for the Milwaukee Bucks back in 80s, and off the court just built a huge and various industries. One being a lot of franchises, and made several hundreds of millions of dollars, and obviously compounded on what these days wouldn't have been that much money made in the NBA what he was making. It's it's kind of amazing what he was able to do.

quotes.speaker: Spencer Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Spencer Jones explains the concept of angel investing
quotes.excerpt: When you're an angel investor, you're going in kind of solo and putting in money into startups.
quotes.quote: When you're an angel investor, you're going in kind of solo and putting in money into startups, which are companies that are very young, only a couple years old. You put money into them to get a piece of equity for if they grow into a Nike or anything like that, you can get a major payout.

quotes.speaker: Spencer Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Spencer Jones on how he discovered Andium shoes
quotes.excerpt: I met them at Summer League last year, and basically I was looking for a shoe.
quotes.quote: I met them at Summer League last year, and basically I was looking for a shoe that could hold up with my style of play. I break through shoes pretty easily. One of the founders came to the hotel and invited this other founder, was founder of Andium, and they had the shoes ready for me and they stayed, had me try them on. I kind of liked them.

quotes.speaker: Spencer Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Spencer Jones on investing in the app Fizz
quotes.excerpt: One made an app called Fizz, which is like a social media app specifically engaged with college students.
quotes.quote: One made an app called Fizz, which is like a social media app specifically engaged with college students on campus to bring community there. They're basically in every college campus around the globe, and now they're launching in Dubai as well. One of my best buddies, his dad, was the CEO of Zoom. It was funny because his dad probably made hundreds of millions of dollars during that period.

quotes.speaker: Spencer Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Spencer Jones on how book smarts translate to basketball
quotes.excerpt: Understanding the game analytically, that's why I'm good at role recognition and I use the book smarts there.
quotes.quote: Understanding the game analytically, that's why I'm good at role recognition and I use the book smarts there, knowing where I have to get on the floor, where I need to take my shots, how I need to shoot, where they're going to come from. Where it hurts is you can get a little too analytical, focusing too much on the numbers. I know I look at percentages and stuff like that and think where I need to shoot rather than just the natural feel of the game.

quotes.speaker: Spencer Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Spencer Jones on the difficulty of guarding Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: He's actually fairly athletic with the angles he's able to take and how quickly he's able to take them.
quotes.quote: He's actually fairly athletic with the angles he's able to take and how quickly he's able to take them on the post as well. Being one of the defenders in training camp, you're going to match up against Nikola Jokic a couple times, and it's just like he finds an angle so quickly. Once he can decipher it so fast, and he always does it at such a quick speed that there's no chance for you to recover.

quotes.speaker: Spencer Jones
quotes.summary_phrase: Spencer Jones on the Generation Schools Network
quotes.excerpt: Generation Schools Network is a nonprofit education system that works with justice engaged youth.
quotes.quote: Generation Schools Network is a nonprofit education system that works with justice engaged youth, meaning kids who are going through the justice system because of bad mistakes. They still need to get an education and most of them honestly just need a secure place to have that education as well. Education has obviously been a huge part of my life, going through my family history, and I know how much it's changed my perspective.
